_comment: Phase 1 starter bestiary. 'ac' is the monster's armor bonus: attackers must roll d20 + bonuses >= 10 + ac to hit. 'damage' is a dice string. 'xp' is awarded to each party member on a kill. 'speed': how many player turns pass between monster moves (1 = every turn, 2 = every other turn). 'save': the monster's saving-throw bonus against spells (d20 + save vs the spell's DC; success = half damage). 'inflicts': {condition, rounds, dc} — on a hit, the victim saves (d20 + ability mod vs dc) or gains the condition.
